correctness.rationale: Conic reduction r^2=I and tr(rg)=0 yields all prescribed two-reflection fibers, including scalar and repeated-root boundaries. GL2 standard character values at split involutions give exactly the determinant, Steinberg and equal-parity principal sectors at all even times; normalization is by |SL2(q)|. Exact type cardinalities and sign inequalities prove total variation. Orthogonality proves chi-square. The final embedded checker enumerates all target fibers and repeated products over q=3,5,7,9,11, with no extrapolation from finite data.

value.rationale: The odd-field split-reflection measure is a natural generating conjugacy class. A full prescribed-target all-time distribution and sharp exact mixing distances are natural group-convolution invariants. The theorem resolves every odd prime-power field and positive pair length, proves first-pair surjectivity and O(1/q) closeness, and isolates a genuine spectral-sector extinction at q=3. This is more than the classical existence theorem or a single numerical sample.
